title: Chip Firm UTAC’s Planned Sale Draws Interest From Sinar Mas, TCL
summary: Private equity firm Wise Road Capital has shortlisted bidders for the potential sale of semiconductor assembly and testing company UTAC Holdings Ltd., according to people familiar with the situation.

title: UK Jobs Market Past Worst Leaves BOE on Track to Hold Rates
summary: The UK labor market appears to be past the worst of a slump triggered by higher taxes, according to official figures that will entrench a cautious approach to more interest-rate cuts at the Bank of England.
